integrity.claim_scope: A four-parameter exact deletion formula, full rational deficiency distribution, sharp deficiency extremum and Dirichlet limiting law; all proved in RESULT.md and finitely checked in verify.py.
integrity.computational_evidence: Finite exhaustive tests are supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: Positive binary four-run words beginning in 0 with \(0<1\); uniform positive-composition random model; length of a longest Lyndon scattered subsequence but not the number of maximizers. A published general algorithm solves individual inputs and does not establish uniqueness or independence of this specialization.
title: Exact longest-Lyndon-subsequence deficiency and its limiting law for four-run binary words
